---
title: Mapping of spaCy string values to `tabulaedspy` objects
---


## Analytic type

`tabulaedspy` defines 11 analytic types. Use this table to determine the correct analytic type to apply for a given spaCy `token`.

| spAcy token tags | analytic type in `tabulaedspy` |
| --- | --- |
| `token.pos_` is `NOUN` | `noun` |
| `token.pos_` is `PRON` | `pronoun` |
| `token.pos_` is  `ADJ` | `adjective` |
| `token.pos_` is  `ADV` | `adverb` |
|`token.morph` includes  `VerbForm=Fin` | `finite verb` |
| `token.morph` includes `VerbForm=Inf` | `infinitive` |
| `token.morph` includes  `VerbForm=Part` | `participle` |
|  `token.morph` includes  `VerbForm=Sup` | `supine` |
|  `token.morph` includes   `VerbForm=Ger` | `gerund` |
|  `token.morph` includes  `VerbForm=Gdv` | `gerundive` |
| `token.morph`  is empty | `uninflected` |



## Properties by type

Use this table to determine the morphological properties required for each analytic type:

| Analytic type | Properties |
| ---  | --- | 
|  "noun" | "gender", "case", "number" |
|   "pronoun" | "gender", "case", "number" |
| "adjective" | "gender", "case", "number", "degree " |
| "adverb" | "degree" |
|    "finite verb" | "tense", "mood", "voice", "person", "number " |
| "infinitive" | "tense", "voice " |
| "participle" | "tense", "voice", "gender", "case", "number " |
|  "supine" | "case" |
|    "gerund" | "case" |
| "gerundive" | "gender", "case", "number " |
|  "uninflected" | "uninflected_type" |



## Values for morphological properties

Use these tables to determine the value for each morphological property required for each analytic type:



### Gender

| spaCy `token.morph` includes |  value |
| --- | --- | 
| `Gender=Masc` | `masculine` |
| `Gender=Fem` | `feminine` |
| `Gender=Neut` | `neuter` |

### Case

Case = Literal["nominative", "genitive", "dative", "accusative", "ablative", "vocative"]

### Number
Number = Literal["singular", "plural"]


### Degree

Degree = Literal["positive", "comparative", "superlative"]

### Tense
Tense = Literal["present", "imperfect", "future", "perfect", "pluperfect", "future_perfect"]

### Mood

Mood = Literal["indicative", "subjunctive", "imperative"]


### Voice
Voice = Literal["active", "passive"]

### Person
Person = Literal["first", "second", "third"]

### Uninflected type
UninflectedType = Literal[
    "conjunction", "preposition", "adverb", "number", "interjection", "particle", "foreign"
]
